subjects.relationship: The obstacle the ego vehicle detects and slows for; the primary hazard in the ego lane

subjects.state_changes: Continues crossing slowly leftward as the ego car slows; legs shift with each careful step, silhouette drifts across the lane
subjects.clothing: dark trousers and dark low-top sneakers visible below the mattress

background_setting: A quiet two-lane suburban road at dusk, framed by low residential houses, parked cars along the curb, trimmed hedges and scattered trees. The sky holds a dim bluish twilight, deepening toward the horizon. Streetlights along the road have just flickered on, casting small warm pools of amber onto the asphalt. Sidewalks flank both sides of the road, and driveways with faint porch lights recede into the distance.

lighting.conditions: Dim bluish twilight at dusk with newly lit streetlights
lighting.direction: Ambient overhead twilight from above, punctuated by pooled downward light from streetlamps and forward throw from the ego headlights
lighting.shadows: Soft, long, low-contrast shadows; the pedestrian's legs cast faint elongated shadows across the lane under the streetlight pools
lighting.illumination_effect: A cool, muted, low-visibility atmosphere where the pale mattress stands out as a bright rectangular shape against the darkening road

aesthetics.composition: Centered forward-driving perspective with the road converging toward a vanishing point; the pale rectangular mattress silhouette anchored mid-frame crossing the ego lane, streetlights framing the sides
aesthetics.color_scheme: Cool blues and slate grays of twilight, dark asphalt, offset by warm amber streetlight glows and the pale beige of the mattress
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Calm, cautious, slightly surreal, quietly tense
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating streetlights and lane markings receding down the road

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking (ego dashcam) that slows in speed as the vehicle decelerates; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from driver POV through the windshield
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the road ahead and the pedestrian carrying the mattress

context: Autonomous driving / ADAS demonstration of recognizing an unusual pedestrian silhouette and slowing to yield

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward down the dusky suburban road; a broad pale rectangular silhouette is noticed crossing the ego lane ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The system recognizes the silhouette as a person carrying a mattress; the vehicle begins to decelerate markedly. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle continues at the reduced speed, rolling slowly to give the pedestrian room as they finish crossing. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
